prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- sign_in, reorder: +3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive pet choice stage redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a stage layout with animated preview cards showing pets performing desktop actions. (why: Adoption conversion is 60.9% with a high mean time of 1017s, indicating users struggle to evaluate static choices.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Quick controls intro step: Add a new screen before home_intro that demonstrates basic desktop pet controls like dragging, hiding, and talking. (why: Support emails showed multiple users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign in after waiting screen: Reorder sign_in to take place after pet generation on the waiting screen so users see their ready pet before signing in. (why: Adoption completion drops significantly; seeing the completed pet first builds high intent before asking for credentials.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo preparation wizard screen: Add a new_photo_guide screen prior to photo upload explaining best lighting and angles for custom pet generation. (why: Support received multiple reports of custom pet creation failing or producing bad visual results.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop pet generation tip carousel: Add a live progress bar, time estimate, and tip carousel to the waiting screen while pet assets build. (why: The waiting screen has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing massive drop-off during background generation.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop launch readiness notification toggle: Add a readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when generation finishes. (why: Waiting mean duration is 2336s (over 38 mins), leading users to minimize or abandon the desktop app while waiting.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path selection clarity copy: Update headline and hint on choose_path to explicitly contrast quick instant adoption versus custom photo creation. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% and users take a mean of 514s trying to figure out what each path does.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Compact sign in layout: Change sign_in layout to compact format to render options immediately above the fold. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalling or failing to load screens properly, and sign-in mean duration is 567s.)
8: [finish, hint] Desktop visibility troubleshooting hint: Add a prominent tip on home_intro explaining how to locate the pet on desktop displays and bring it to front. (why: Support received 3 bug reports stating that pets do not show up on the desktop after completing onboarding.)
